articles.summary: $275 Million of Accretive Investment Activity During the Quarter Innovative Industrial Properties, Inc. (NYSE: IIPR) ("IIP" or the "Company") announced today results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Executive Chairman Remarks “We are pleased to report strong earnings with our AFFO per share up 7% compared to the second quarter, and are encouraged by the continued leasing momentum across our portfolio, reflecting our team's ongoing efforts to re-lease properties,” said Alan Gold, Executive Chairman of IIP. “At the same time, our recently announced $245 million mezzanine loan commitment at Alewife Park further expands our presence in the life science sector. Together, these initiatives reflect our focus on improving the performance of our existing portfolio while deploying capital into investments that we believe will drive earnings growth and create long-term value for our shareholders.” Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Dividend Total revenues of $64.9 million
articles.title: Innovative Industrial Properties Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
